name: Oklahoma 10-point Pitch
description: Oklahoma Ten Point Pitch is a partnership trick-taking variant of Pitch using a 52-card deck plus two jokers. Points come from High, Low, Jack, Off-Jack, High Joker, Low Joker, Game, and optionally the Three of trumps. First team to 21 wins.

overview.description: Oklahoma Ten Point Pitch is a partnership trick-taking variant of Pitch using a 52-card deck plus two jokers. Points come from High, Low, Jack, Off-Jack, High Joker, Low Joker, Game, and optionally the Three of trumps. First team to 21 wins.

history.origins: A Pitch variant from Oklahoma, closely related to Minnesota Smear. Introduces jokers and Off-Jack as additional scoring trumps.
timeline: Mid-20th century: Regional Pitch variant in Oklahoma and Midwest.
Present: Popular in partnership Pitch circles.
history.cultural: Partnership family game in the American Midwest.
history.evolution: Adds Off-Jack (same-color Jack as trump Jack) and High/Low Jokers to the trump suit, expanding from 4 to 7 or 10 points per hand.

setup.deck: Standard 52-card deck plus two distinguishable jokers. Off-Jack = Jack of same color as trump Jack.
setup.dealing: 4 players: 9 cards each. 6 players: 8 cards each. Remaining cards form widow.

rules.objective: Be the first partnership to reach 21 points by capturing scoring cards in tricks.
rules.gameplay: 1. Deal 9 (4p) or 8 (6p) cards each. 2. Bid 2-10 (or 2-7 without trey). Dealer cannot steal the bid. 3. Bidder declares trump. 4. Discard and draw to 6 cards. 5. Play: bidder leads. Follow suit or trump. 6. Score: High, Low, Jack, Off-Jack, Jokers, Game (1 each); Trey 3 (optional). First to 21 wins.
keyRules: Trump order: A, K, Q, J, Off-Jack, High Joker, Low Joker, 10-2.
Low = held by team (lowest trump in play).
Bid and make: score points. Set: lose bid, opponents score.
Win only when reaching 21+ on a hand where you made your bid.

strategy.basic: Count trumps; bid conservatively. Protect Off-Jack and jokers.
strategy.intermediate: Use discard phase to load trumps. Lead trump to draw high cards.
strategy.advanced: Track scoring cards played. Coordinate with partner.
